description: Strips non-essential tracking, crash reporting, and debug companion native libraries in lib/** (e.g. libcrashlytics, libsentry, libbugly, libgwp-asan) by zeroing bytes in-situ.
name: Universal Native Binary Trimmer

options.description: Zero native crash reporting and tracking libraries (Crashlytics, Sentry, Bugly, PLCrashReporter).
options.title: Trim Crash Reporting Libraries

options.description: Zero debug memory and profiling libraries (GWP-ASan, Simpleperf, Android Studio profilers).
options.title: Trim Debug & Profiling Libraries

description: Forces offline execution across any application by revoking INTERNET and network permissions from AndroidManifest.xml and blocking cleartext HTTP traffic at the OS level.
name: Universal Offline Mode

options.description: Also remove ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE and ACCESS_WIFI_STATE permissions. Default is false to prevent SecurityException crashes in apps that query network status without error handling.
options.title: Strip Network State Permissions

options.description: Remove CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE, CHANGE_WIFI_STATE, CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE, and NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES permissions.
options.title: Strip Wi-Fi Control Permissions

options.description: Remove Google Cloud Messaging and Firebase Cloud Messaging push receiver permissions (com.google.android.c2dm.permission.RECEIVE).
options.title: Strip Push Notification Permissions

options.description: Remove Google Services Framework and account sync permissions (com.google.android.providers.gsf.permission.READ_GSERVICES, android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS).
options.title: Strip Google Services Sync Permissions

options.description: Enforce android:usesCleartextTraffic='false' on the application tag in AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Block Cleartext Traffic

description: Strips advertising and Privacy Sandbox permissions, disables analytics ContentProviders and telemetry background services (Firebase, Sentry, Adjust, AppsFlyer, DataTransport), and injects telemetry opt-out metadata.
name: Universal Telemetry Neutralizer

options.description: Remove AD_ID, Privacy Sandbox attribution/topics/audiences, and Play Install Referrer permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Revoke Advertising & Tracking Permissions

options.description: Disable analytics ContentProviders (Google Measurement, Sentry, Facebook, Flurry, Branch, AppsFlyer).
options.title: Disable Telemetry ContentProviders

options.description: Disable Google Measurement, Google DataTransport, and AppsFlyer background job services.
options.title: Disable Telemetry Background Services

options.description: Disable install referrer and analytics measurement broadcast receivers (Adjust, AppsFlyer, Google Measurement).
options.title: Disable Telemetry Receivers

options.description: Inject meta-data opt-out entries into application tag (Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance, AppsFlyer, Sentry).
options.title: Inject Telemetry Opt-Out Flags

options.description: Disable com.google.firebase.provider.FirebaseInitProvider. Default is false to prevent issues in apps that depend on Firebase Auth or push notifications.
options.title: Disable Firebase Init Provider

description: Losslessly strips non-rendering metadata and ancillary chunks (EXIF, XMP, ICCP) from WebP assets across res/ and assets/ to reduce APK size.
name: Universal WebP Asset Optimizer

options.description: Remove camera parameters, geolocation, and creator metadata chunks from WebP images.
options.title: Strip EXIF Metadata

options.description: Remove Adobe XMP XML metadata chunks from WebP images.
options.title: Strip XMP Metadata

options.description: Remove ICCP color profile chunks. Default is false to preserve color profile fidelity on wide-gamut displays.
options.title: Strip ICC Color Profiles

description: Unlocks local Hevy Pro capabilities (unlimited workout routines, routine folders, advanced graphs, and local analytics) by dynamically enabling Pro getters and suppressing grace period payment warnings in Hermes Bytecode (HBC96).
name: Unlock Pro

description: Neutralizes background update polling tasks and device ID check routines to prevent forced update popups.
name: Update Prompt Suppressor

description: Caps video playback and download resolutions (1080p, 720p, 540p, 480p, 360p) independently to conserve battery, GPU/MediaCodec load, and mobile data.
name: Video Quality Governor

options.description: Select maximum video playback resolution ceiling: 1080 (1080p ExtremelyHigh), 720 (720p SuperHigh), 540 (540p H_High), 480 (480p High), or 360 (360p Standard).
options.title: Maximum Playback Resolution

options.description: Select maximum video download resolution ceiling: 1080 (1080p Maximum Quality), 720 (720p SuperHigh), 540 (540p H_High), 480 (480p High), or 360 (360p Standard).
options.title: Maximum Download Resolution

description: Guards against fatal CompositorView NullPointerException crashes on cold startup and bypasses carrier partner customizations.
name: Vivaldi Startup Performance Optimization

description: Bypasses Xposed and hook detection, neutralizes VPN and ADB security checks, bypasses root and emulator detection, and hardens WebView JavaScript bridges.
name: Xiaomi Earbuds Anti-Tamper Bypass

dependencies: Xiaomi Earbuds Background Services Manifest Purge
description: Neutralizes KeepAliveForegroundService, background BLE observation, companion device manager, and MIUI Nearby discovery to eliminate persistent notifications, wakelocks, and background battery drain.
name: Xiaomi Earbuds Background Optimizer

description: Neutralizes Firebase Analytics, Xiaomi OneTrack, AutoReportHelper, and GlobalReport telemetry and event dispatching.
name: Xiaomi Earbuds Block Telemetry & Trackers

dependencies: Xiaomi Earbuds Device Privacy Guard Manifest Purge
description: Blinds hardware device IDs, anonymizes device identifiers, neutralizes environment info leakage, and bypasses location checks for Bluetooth scanning.
name: Xiaomi Earbuds Device Privacy Guard

description: Bypasses startup privacy agreements, onboarding guides, region selector prompts, and Bluetooth permission nags, and disables in-app promotional banners, marketing activities, and store review nag dialogs.
name: Xiaomi Earbuds Disable Promos & Nags

description: Bypasses mandatory Xiaomi account login checks for firmware update queries, allowing guest users to check and perform device OTA updates.
name: Xiaomi Earbuds Guest OTA Unlock

description: Forces DeviceInfoListCache.isShowProduct to return true, bypassing version-gating and distribution restrictions so that all device models are always displayed and discoverable.
name: Xiaomi Earbuds Model Catalog Unlock

description: Disables cleartext traffic, trusts user-installed certificates, and bypasses OkHttp certificate pinning.
name: Xiaomi Earbuds Network Security & TLS Inspection

description: Completely isolates the app from the network by revoking internet permissions and spoofing offline status to prevent background socket failures.
name: Xiaomi Earbuds Offline Only

description: Unblocks Spatial Audio, hearing enhancement, and voice wake-up restrictions, unbans Spatial Audio on 96kHz aptX Adaptive connections, and bypasses XPAN requirements.
name: Xiaomi Earbuds Sound Features Unlock

description: Bypasses Xiaomi OEM hardware gating for SuperAivs (function 5009) and suppresses MIUI-specific spatial audio system dialog nags.
name: Xiaomi Earbuds Surgical OEM Unlock
